## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in this focused package.

## Contract and boundaries

- [ ] Public API and finding changes are documented.
- [ ] The change does not imply semantic support, source trust, authority, or factual truth without
      actually assessing it.
- [ ] Architecture changes include an accepted ADR.
- [ ] No private code, prompts, policies, data, or secrets are included.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has positive, negative, and adversarial tests where applicable.
- [ ] Security and denial-of-service implications were reviewed.
- [ ] I can explain the implementation and its tradeoffs.
